[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested several BBQ chicken breast recipes:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Honey Garlic BBQ Chicken: Marinate chicken breasts in honey, garlic, olive oil, salt, and pepper, then grill or bake, brushing with BBQ sauce in the last 10 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Korean-Style BBQ Chicken: Marinate chicken breasts in soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, and gochujang, then grill or bake, brushing with BBQ sauce and topping with sesame seeds and green onions.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Jerk BBQ Chicken: Marinate chicken breasts in jerk seasoning, olive oil, lime juice, and BBQ sauce, then grill or bake, serving with grilled pineapple and coconut rice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. BBQ Chicken Tacos: Marinate chicken breasts in lime juice, olive oil, cumin, chili powder, and BBQ sauce, then grill or bake, shred, and serve in tacos with toppings.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Grilled Chicken Shawarma: Marinate chicken breasts in olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and oregano, then grill or bake, serving in pita with BBQ sauce, tomato, onion, and tzatziki.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Smoky BBQ Chicken Salad: Grill or bake chicken breasts, chop, and toss with mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, red onion, blue cheese, and BBQ sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. BBQ Chicken Wings (without the wings!): Marinate chicken breasts in hot sauce and butter, grill or bake until crispy, and serve with celery sticks and blue cheese dressing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for achieving perfect grill marks on chicken breasts:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Clean grill grates and brush with oil before heating.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Preheat grill to medium-high heat (400°F to 425°F).
